title: [Master]-Subscription Billing: Recurring Billing (Document Per = Contract Partner) Overwrites Contract Currency with Customer Currency Without Amount Conversion.
summary: Subscription Billing now correctly carries the contract currency to generated invoices instead of defaulting to local currency.
key_points: Invoice creation from contracts now takes the currency code from the related contract line
Before this change, invoices were created with a blank currency code, which is treated as local currency
Change is in the Create Billing Documents codeunit, with a new recurring billing test
